inputs.name: sshd_settings
inputs.description: sshd keywords to add to the built-in settings or replace them, such as { AllowTcpForwarding = "yes" }. A null value leaves that keyword out of the drop-in.

inputs.name: sshd_moduli_minimum
inputs.description: Remove Diffie-Hellman group exchange primes smaller than this many bits from /etc/ssh/moduli. 0 leaves the file alone.

inputs.name: sysctl
inputs.description: Kernel parameters to add to the built-in settings or replace them, by name. A null value leaves that parameter out.

inputs.name: disabled_modules
inputs.description: Kernel modules modprobe refuses to load. An empty list leaves the circuit's modprobe file with only its header.

inputs.name: core_dumps
inputs.description: Allow core dumps. When false, the circuit turns them off for login sessions, setuid programs and systemd-coredump.

inputs.name: login_umask
inputs.description: UMASK in /etc/login.defs, which pam_umask and useradd read. null leaves the line alone.

inputs.name: cron_permissions
inputs.description: Take group and other access off /etc/crontab and the /etc/cron.* directories that exist.

inputs.name: remove_packages
inputs.description: Packages to remove when installed. Names a distribution doesn't have are skipped.
